We have delivered rapid robotization at scale. Now we are developing and deploying Physical AI products that use intelligence, flexibility and adaptability to go a step beyond traditional automation. Humanoid robots Humanoid robots bring Physical AI into environments built for people. Agile Robots develops them for every stage, from the research lab to the production floor. Find out more Diana 7: The art of dexterity Developed to intuitively perform any automation task, this force-controlled robotic arm is equipped with torque sensors in all seven axes and is supported by our AI-driven software. Find out more Thor series: Precision meets payload The Thor series is engineered to meet diverse industrial needs, providing payload options of 3, 7, 12, and 20 kilograms along with unique features tailored to different applications. This versatility allows Thor to excel in both ultra-precise operations and heavy-duty applications. Find out more Human-like touch: Agile Hand The anthropomorphic Agile Hand is composed of five identical, modularly designed robotic fingers. Thanks to its humanoid dexterity, it can perform delicate tasks and offers a hand where we humans can’t. Find out more Shared Expertise: Mobile robotics We develop our cutting-edge Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) solution in partnership with our experts at BÄR Automation and idealworks. Components can be flexibly combined with each other so that individual steps can be synchronized optimally, to enhance efficiency and flexibility, streamline operations and boost productivity in a wide range of environments. Find out more Everything connected: AgileCore Our powerful software platform enables system integrators and operators to develop and deploy next-generation automation solutions. It’s like a one-stop shop for all your robotic software needs. Cutting-edge AI technology powers our robotic systems: AgileAI is the brain of our automation solutions, enabling them to process data, make real-time decisions and flexibly adapt to changing conditions. It can be programmed using natural language. This advanced platform enhances our robots’ performance, driving innovation and efficiency across various applications. Find out more We are proud of our long track record of consistently developing the right solutions to meet specific application needs across a broad range of industries and services. Driving innovation We are pushing the boundaries of physical AI products: intelligent, flexible and adaptable robots that get tasks done. Agile Robots develops them for every stage, from the research lab to the production floor. Agile ONE: Physical AI for the production floor Agile ONE brings Physical AI to industry. The full-size humanoid moves autonomously between workstations, collaborates with people and handles complex, variable tasks. Trained on real industrial data, Agile ONE learns and adapts with every task. Discover Agile ONE Agile ONE S: The open reference humanoid platform Agile ONE S is a compact humanoid built for research labs, universities and developers. Researchers equip it with the end effector that fits their work and connect it to their own software stack. Discover Agile ONE S Agile ONE SN: The humanoid reference platform Agile ONE SN is Agile ONE S, with Dual Wuji five-finger hands and preconfigured for NVIDIA Isaac™ GR00T. From data capture to real-world testing, research teams can start developing robot skills right away.
